svg.title: The Grand Orrery — a brass clockwork solar system
svg.desc: A brass clockwork orrery in brass and blued steel. Eight toothed wheels geared to a central arbor carry the planets at their true relative orbital speeds (Mercury 0.241 yr … Neptune 164.8 yr). An escape wheel drives a selector pinion riding on the outer ring. Each planet turns on its own axis at its true relative rotation period — Venus and Uranus retrograde — while a day-and-night terminator shadow is swept across its surface, always facing away from the sun.
svg.text: DE ORRERIO MUNDI ANCEPS · VERE RELATIONERotationIS
